method_summary.cohort: Pathologist-reviewed FFPE EMC sections from a study involving Siriraj Thailand and Columbia USA; do not infer every specimen is Thai.
method_summary.extraction: An area of interest was scraped from slide-mounted FFPE tissue and lysed for TempO-Seq Human Whole Transcriptome2.0. No tumor-purity percentage identified in inspected methods.
method_summary.identity: Abstract molecular-confirmation wording is broader than reported assay: EWSR1 break-apartFISH,8positive/4negative in analyzedcohort; no NR4A3-partner confirmation for all12 established.
method_summary.assay: Hybridization-ligation detector oligos target protein-coding genes; processed export contains9500rows/12specimens. Gene-level target signal is not full-length transcript or spatial localization.
method_summary.spatial_assay: Multiplex immunofluorescence performed on2specimens for authorsselectedproteins/immune markers; noTMEM266spatial measurement recovered.
